scope: Committed issuer history and bounded production revocation watcher
invariant: Return committed revocations in order, or report failure without silently skipping history.
required_evidence: Both authorized hosts in Debug and ASan/UBSan
Complete P00-P10 baseline and unchanged acceptance lock
Committed order, bounded pagination, rollback, and restart
Independent malformed TLS replies and production queue overflow
Direct cross-host notification through the production watcher
limitations: A successful issuer revoke response does not acknowledge world cancellation.
Authenticated world entry, current action checks, and immediate live revocation remain required.
Nonempty bootstrap profiles and scoped grants remain required.
